name: llm-eval-guardrails
description: Evaluation and guardrails harness for LLM, RAG, and agentic applications: a JSONL case set, deterministic and LLM-as-judge scoring, snapshot regression detection, and a CI quality gate that is itself tested against injected defects

scripts.gate:dataset: tsx src/cli.ts gate --dataset datasets --responses datasets/responses/good.json --snapshot-dir baselines --baseline good
scripts.gate:selftest: tsx src/cli.ts gate --dataset datasets --responses datasets/responses/degraded.json --snapshot-dir baselines --baseline good --expect-fail
scripts.baseline:update: tsx src/cli.ts snapshot --dataset datasets --responses datasets/responses/good.json --snapshot-dir baselines --version good

author: Douglas Bonafé
